product_metadata.title: Sibosen 5 ft Premium Artificial Christmas Tree for Holiday Indoor Outdoor Party Decoration w/ 700 Branch Tips, Easy Assembly, Metal Hinges & Folding Base
features: 🎄Full Appearance: The 5-foot xmas tree extends 7500 tips. Full branches are vivid looking and offer more holiday atmosphere by customizing with garland, lights, ornaments, etc
🎄Tips for Full Tree: Please make it fluff-out, full and dense by simply lifting up the top tips and pulling out the side tips. About 45-60 min, the christmas tree fully fluff-out
🎄Natural Lifelike Branches: PVC branches support the shape and display a deep forest green color when fluffed make the season complete
🎄Stable No Lean: 3-hinged design for branches, X-shaped metal base make the tree stand firmly at home, office, shops or outdoor areas for Christmas decoration
🎄Durable to Last: Built with durable hinges and flame-resistant PVC branches on the sturdy metal base enable the tree to endure many holiday seasons

🎄Easy Assemble and Store: Simply connect the metal base, attach the remaining 2 sections and fluff-out the branches. Same way to dismantle for storage. Overall Dimensions: 30"(Dia) x 60"(H) (including stand)
🎄Hassle-free warranty for free return, replacement or refund if you have any issues!
